title: The 'association' of 24 retired officials pushing UAP programs back under government oversight
summary: Dan Sheehan tells of The 'association' of 24 retired officials pushing UAP programs back under government oversight, about present at Defense Department, CIA, aerospace corporations, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: There has arisen uh an insurgency group that have uh occupied extremely high positions uh in the defense department uh inside the central intelligence agency

plain: Dan Sheehan, a guest on a podcast, passes on what a man named Michael Phillip told him: that an "insurgency" has formed, a group of about 24 retired officials who once held very high positions in the US Defense Department, the CIA (America's foreign intelligence agency) and big aerospace companies. According to Sheehan, this group is pushing to bring secret programmes about UAP, the official term for UFOs, back under proper government oversight. If true, it would mean insiders themselves are working to rein in hidden programmes.
